一堆.reason: Retain the literal one-pile reading. The number of members is unspecified, but the classifier explicitly counts one pile; no unit conversion is performed.

一共.reason: Conventional idiomatic expression; do not extract the numeral glyph as a numeric substring.

一手.reason: Retain the literal one-hand reading, explicitly listed first in the Ministry of Education dictionary; polysemy alone does not justify rejecting its explicit cardinal.

一年级.reason: First grade is ordinal; ordinals are excluded.

这样一.reason: Incomplete demonstrative phrase; not a self-contained numeric quantity.

那一.reason: Incomplete demonstrative phrase; not a self-contained numeric quantity.

四五.reason: Four/five, not forty-five; matches the preceding audit convention for 五六 and 一二.

万.reason: Complete Chinese/Japanese cardinal ten thousand; a gold-independent false-negative found in the common-cardinal audit.
